question: What residual scope should #54397 own now that Web UI pin/archive/rename/sidebar work and `/name` are merged: CLI/TUI verbs, topic metadata/import-export, topic-family model, or only links to narrower issues?
rationale: Current main solves several visible UI and chat-naming slices, but the remaining scope crosses state model, protocol, CLI/TUI UX, privacy, and import/export decisions that automation should not choose.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Slices
options.body: Keep #54397 open as the broad session/topic UX tracker while routing lifecycle commands to #63118, topic-family state to #90916, and any accepted CLI/TUI/import-export pieces into focused follow-ups.

options.title: Close After Canonical Links
options.body: If maintainers consider Web UI/sidebar/picker management sufficient for this umbrella, close it only after linking the remaining canonical issues that own CLI lifecycle and topic-family state.

options.title: Sponsor New Core Topic Model Here
options.body: Use this issue as the product owner for a staged topic metadata/import-export/family model, accepting that it will need design review before code starts.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Slices
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open as the broad session/topic UX tracker while routing lifecycle commands to #63118, topic-family state to #90916, and any accepted CLI/TUI/import-export pieces into focused follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged session-thread management foundation and are the strongest current owner signal for deciding whether the remaining scope stays under this umbrella or splits.
